mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_STUDENT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION WHERE TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID = #{teacherStudentAccessId} AND VERIFICATION_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND CONSUMED_AT IS NULL AND INVALIDATED_AT IS NULL AND LOCKED_UNTIL IS NULL AND FAILED_ATTEMPT_COUNT < 5 ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, VERIFICATION_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_STUDENT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_STUDENT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION ( VERIFICATION_ID, TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID, EMAIL_HASH, CODE_HASH, VERIFICATION_STATUS, FAILED_ATTEMPT_COUNT, EXPIRES_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{verificationId}, #{teacherStudentAccessId}, #{emailHash}, #{codeHash}, #{verificationStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=com.yunki.lessonpt.common.mybatis.typehandler.StudentEmailVerificationStatusTypeHandler}, #{failedAttemptCount}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STUDENT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION SET VERIFICATION_STATUS = 'INVALIDATED', INVALIDATED_AT = #{invalidatedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID = #{teacherStudentAccessId} AND VERIFICATION_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND CONSUMED_AT IS NULL AND INVALIDATED_AT IS NULL AND LOCKED_UNTIL IS NULL

UPDATE TB_STUDENT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION SET FAILED_ATTEMPT_COUNT = #{failedAttemptCount}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE VERIFICATION_ID = #{verificationId} AND VERIFICATION_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND FAILED_ATTEMPT_COUNT = #{failedAttemptCount} - 1 AND FAILED_ATTEMPT_COUNT < 4 AND CONSUMED_AT IS NULL AND INVALIDATED_AT IS NULL AND LOCKED_UNTIL IS NULL

UPDATE TB_STUDENT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION SET VERIFICATION_STATUS = 'CONSUMED', CONSUMED_AT = #{consumedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE VERIFICATION_ID = #{verificationId} AND VERIFICATION_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND FAILED_ATTEMPT_COUNT < 5 AND CONSUMED_AT IS NULL AND INVALIDATED_AT IS NULL AND LOCKED_UNTIL IS NULL

UPDATE TB_STUDENT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION SET VERIFICATION_STATUS = 'LOCKED', FAILED_ATTEMPT_COUNT = 5, LOCKED_UNTIL = #{lockedUntil}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE VERIFICATION_ID = #{verificationId} AND VERIFICATION_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND FAILED_ATTEMPT_COUNT = 4 AND CONSUMED_AT IS NULL AND INVALIDATED_AT IS NULL AND LOCKED_UNTIL IS NULL
